subject: Request to pause automated card-retry for Starlite account and manual collection plan
messages:
From: Julie Hansen <payments@starlite-retail.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multiple pending auths from automatic retries — request to opt out

Hi Vivek / Monica,

We're seeing an unusual pattern after your platform retried a batch of failed charges for our July invoices (invoice IDs: INV-2027-07-1031, INV-2027-07-1042). For at least 12 customers Stripe shows multiple pending authorizations (same charge attempted several times) and two customers have already filed disputes claiming duplicate authorizations.

Can Redwood temporarily disable the automated card-retry behavior for our account? Our payments team prefers coordinated manual retries to avoid duplicate pending auths and further disputes while we work through the affected card-on-file tokens with our customers.

Attached: stripe-decline-log.csv (sample: decline codes, timestamps, customer_token).

We'd like:
- Auto-retry paused for Starlite Retail (all subscriptions) until we confirm tokens are reconciled.
- A documented manual retry plan (who will run, when, idempotency guidance).

Please advise next steps and whether we need a signed change order.

Thanks,
Julie
Payments Operations
Starlite Retail
(415) 555-1212
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Hansen <payments@starlite-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multiple pending auths from automatic retries — request to opt out

Julie — thanks for the heads-up and the CSV. I'm escalating to payments ops (Ben) and our billing lead (Monica).

High level plan I propose:
1) Temporarily disable Redwood automated retry policy for Starlite (scope: account_id SLT-43321).
2) Redwood payments team to provide a one-off manual retry playbook (idempotency key usage + recommended timing).
3) Finance to pause automated invoice re-send / dunning emails for 72 hours to reduce customer confusion.

Ben / Monica — can you confirm feasibility and an ETA for making the change? Julie — if you can share the Stripe customer_ids for the rows in the CSV that will speed the manual attempts.

Happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julie Hansen <payments@starlite-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multiple pending auths from automatic retries — request to opt out

Looping in finance_ops and payments runbook. Charging a note here for the internal ticket — RH-5521 (attached). Proposed ops steps: 

- Immediate: set routing policy flag autoretry=false for account SLT-43321 (this only affects Redwood-side orchestrated retries; we won't touch Stripe native settings).
- Within 24 hours: payments team will produce a manual retry schedule (list of customer_ids, preferred retry windows, idempotency key strategy).
- 48–72 hours: Finance to pause dunning emails and suspend automatic escalation to collections for the affected invoices. We will not reattempt via automated route during this window.

Legal note: If disputes have already been filed, Legal needs the dispute IDs (Julie, please attach if you can) so we can coordinate evidence submission and avoid conflicting attempts that could worsen outcomes.

Attaching: redwood-payments-ticket-RH-5521.txt (ticket summary).

Ben — can you scope the change and confirm whether we need a maintenance window?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julie Hansen <payments@starlite-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multiple pending auths from automatic retries — request to opt out

We can implement the flag change without a customer-facing maintenance window — it's a routing-policy toggle on our orchestration layer. Steps and notes: 

- Action: set account-level policy SLT-43321.autoretry = false. ETA: 2 hours.
- Reconcile: we'll mark the affected invoices with a metadata tag "manual_review_requested" so downstream collectors don't touch them.
- Manual retry guidance: use idempotency_key = "SLT-<invoice>-manual-<epoch>" and wait 48 hours between attempts per-card. Recommend max 2 manual attempts before escalating to customer.
- Stripe idempotency: ensure client-provided keys match Redwood-run attempts to avoid duplicate charges.

Attached: autoretry-config-diff.patch (shows the routing policy change). I will also open a short Slack thread with PaymentsOps to coordinate live attempts.

Ben Carter
Payments Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Julie Hansen <payments@starlite-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multiple pending auths from automatic retries — request to opt out

Julie — quick update and next steps: 

- We've toggled autoretry=false for SLT-43321 (complete at 14:05 PDT; change id RH-5521).
- Finance has paused automated dunning for the flagged invoices for 72 hours.
- Payments ops (Ben) will run a coordinated manual retry tomorrow between 10:00–14:00 PDT for the customer_ids you provide. Please reply with the full Stripe customer_ids for the lines in your CSV and any dispute IDs you mentioned.

If you prefer a signed change order for an account-level setting change, we can generate one — otherwise we'll proceed with the manual plan once we have the customer_ids.

Thanks for catching this early — we'll minimize further dispute risk.

Best regards,
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(650) 555-0199
